message:
3pm on a monday in [canggu](kebi://area/id/bali/canggu) is actually a great time to be out, lighter crowds before the sunset rush hits.

given you're into waterfront spots, [The Lawn Canggu](kebi://venue/3dbb0a08-bd83-40b0-b581-5a87a76a611f) is the move right now. it's right on the water on jl. pura dalem, and 3pm is the sweet spot before the sunbed crowd fills in. get there now, grab a spot, drink in hand, and let the afternoon run into sunset.

[La Brisa](kebi://venue/aaf5dd63-7fe8-4b77-8f57-5197e3e7dce5) is worth knowing too, it's on [batu](kebi://venue/7872c6f9-ef30-4d0b-b8a8-828b35e6e063) mejan beach, beautiful open-air bamboo setup, a bit more relaxed and scenic than the lawn. good if you want something a touch quieter with the same waterfront feel.

if you want the bigger production, [Finns Beach Club](kebi://venue/c61dd547-cc0d-452a-a5d2-f13d3751d1c6) over in berawa is open every day, pools, DJs, full beach club energy. it's a proper afternoon-into-evening spot, just a short ride west.

and if the afternoon rolls into a night out, [Old Man's](kebi://venue/45a09352-bfd6-403a-b5c5-7b23699a1ce2) on batu bolong runs every day, easy classic beach bar stop, and [Sand Bar](kebi://venue/f01f4435-631c-41e9-a3a9-f05356eb82c2) does afterparties every night so that's a natural end.

are you thinking just the afternoon or do you want to plan the whole evening too?
